rationale: The prior major is resolved. The focus-card action is now 'Contact Mina', rendered enabled in both default and error at both sizes, with no disabled attribute in source (index.html:6). The only restricted control in error is 'New walk', natively disabled with aria-describedby pointing at the alert body, which says new walks are paused and names Retry (index.html:5-6). Retry is enabled and directly adjacent to it. No second disabled mutation exists and default shows 'New walk' enabled with no Retry. The swap introduced no new material defect: the contact action is safe during an outage and its feedback text is specific. Remaining items are the prior minors plus Retry's distance from the alert, which the outcome does not gate.
